meta.source: DAFI 36-2406, Officer and Enlisted Evaluation Systems: major performance areas and Airman Leadership Qualities; myEval EPB character limits
meta.notes: The four major performance area descriptions, the Airman Leadership Qualities under each, and the character limits (450 for the duty description, 350 per performance statement, 250 for the higher level reviewer assessment) were transcribed from a unit-built EPB workbench PDF that carried them as myEval shows them. They have not yet been read back against the published instruction or a live myEval session. Every count here is a plain character count, spaces included, which is how myEval counts.

sections.title: Executing the Mission
sections.description: Effectively uses knowledge, initiative, and adaptability to produce timely, high quality/quantity results to positively impact the mission.

qualities.name: Job Proficiency
qualities.text: Demonstrates knowledge and professional skill in assigned duties, achieving positive results and impact in support of the mission.

qualities.name: Adaptability
qualities.text: Adjusts to changing conditions, to include plans, information, processes, requirements and obstacles in accomplishing the mission.

qualities.name: Initiative
qualities.text: Assesses and takes independent or directed action to complete a task or mission that influences the mission or organization.

sections.title: Leading People
sections.description: Fosters cohesive teams, effectively communicates, and uses emotional intelligence to take care of people and accomplish the mission.

qualities.name: Inclusion & Teamwork
qualities.text: Collaborates effectively with others to achieve an inclusive climate in pursuit of a common goal or to complete a task or mission.

qualities.name: Emotional Intelligence
qualities.text: Exercises self-awareness, manages their own emotions effectively; demonstrates an understanding of others' emotions, and appropriately manages relationships.

qualities.name: Communication
qualities.text: Articulates information in a clear and timely manner, both verbally and non-verbally, through active listening and messaging tailored to the appropriate audience.

sections.title: Managing Resources
sections.description: Manages assigned resources effectively and takes responsibility for actions/behaviors to maximize organizational performance.

qualities.name: Stewardship
qualities.text: Demonstrates responsible management of assigned resources, which may include time, equipment, people, funds, and/or facilities.

qualities.name: Accountability
qualities.text: Takes responsibility for the actions and behaviors of self and/or team; demonstrates reliability and transparency.

sections.title: Improving the Unit
sections.description: Demonstrates critical thinking and fosters innovation to find creative solutions and improve mission execution.

qualities.name: Decision Making
qualities.text: Makes well-informed, effective and timely decisions under one's control that weigh constraints, risks, and benefits.

qualities.name: Innovation
qualities.text: Thinks creatively about different ways to solve problems, implements improvements and demonstrates calculated risk-taking.
